notes: Aggregates current Form W-2G box 1 winnings into the family subtotal that Schedule 1 line 8b reports (i1040gi-2025 l.6561-6575). Guards its own collect: the family must be confirmed closed (an unconfirmed family is SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED). Core v67 (gambling-losses): the subtotal no longer reads the Schedule A gambling/other declaration. Gambling losses are now recorded in their own confirmed family and reach Schedule A line 16 limited to these winnings (rule.schedule-a-line16), so a filer with losses is no longer refused here. A statement with no box 1 amount recorded is not a member and adds nothing. Publishes the sum with cents; the line that reads it rounds once.
